crossRefs.note: Till the land for him, you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread…
Give us today our daily bread.
Give us day by day our daily bread.
crossRefs.keyword: every day a portion. Heb. the matter of the day in his day

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
translations.bsb: And the king of Babylon provided Jehoiachin a daily portion for the rest of his life, until the day of his death.
translations.kjv: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
translations.asv: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
